Bascom shook his head.

If we involved Tampico Petroleum, and anything serious should break down there, you’d be finished, cleaned out, broke.", "sha256": "a4a02fb4759f6fcea93b3c26d61067d83647c1832cfcd3ddf1756b6e40b05c31", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2270]", "source_html": "

“There’s the Mexican revolution, and our own spineless administration. If we involved Tampico Petroleum, and anything serious should break down there, you’d be finished, cleaned out, broke.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u026-r0066", "tag": "p", "text": "“And yet,” Bascom resumed, “I see no other way out than to use Tampico Petroleum. You see, I have almost exhausted what you have placed in my hands. And this is no whirlwind raid. It’s slow and steady as an advancing glacier. I’ve only handled the market for you all these years, and this is the first tight place we’ve got into. Now your general business affairs? Collins has the handling and knows. You must know. What securities can you let me have? Now? And to-morrow? And next week? And the next three weeks?”", "sha256": "d29c6a8276507a67378b6a5c6768364a44dbf7f51b3caef4fb9dc95de4eccee9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2271]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u026-r0067", "tag": "p", "text": "“How much do you want?” Francis questioned back.", "sha256": "cd989e48d61aa0de7ccc8ba631bdb6981a42a17ef6c502ed8949c322be0f069c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2272]", "source_html": "

“How much do you want?” Francis questioned back.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u026-r0068", "tag": "p", "text": "“A million before closing time to-day.” Bascom pointed eloquently at the ticker. “At least twenty million more in the next three weeks, if——and mark you that [[I]]if[[/I]] well——if the world remains at peace, and if the general market remains as normal as it has been for the past six months.”", "sha256": "2c014ed04d33bc0873396d19c5b443157d3cb3a15f2b3c6f2f9805d193b5d845", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2273]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 1}, {"id": "ru78-u026-r0069", "tag": "p", "text": "Francis stood up with decision and reached for his hat.", "sha256": "03c0122ea5710b91b9b43f8e084c978cdf3ae708d56a67e557f5f77b0df479bc", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2274]", "source_html": "

Francis stood up with decision and reached for his hat.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u026-r0070", "tag": "p", "text": "“I’m going to Collins at once. He knows far more about my outside business than I know myself. Whoever is making it, is doing it big, and must be big.”", "sha256": "97ac9c0413805e6a548041d09fe98777f418a1fd99e21aa05507ec9a4a76b833", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2276]", "source_html": "

To her delight, in her own room, by her bedside, she found a telephone, through which, by calling up Collins’ office, she gave her good night to Francis. Also, she essayed to kiss her heart to him, and received back, queer and vague of sound, his answering kiss.", "sha256": "489fc5633b1396fcae1afb6ed5ebb860770548dcde327e6d6a5c3af63604295a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2277]", "source_html": "

She knew not how long she had slept, when she awoke. Not moving, through her half-open eyes she saw Francis peer into the room and across to her. When he had gone softly away, she leapt out of bed and ran to the door in time to see him start down the staircase.

She looked at herself in the mirror, adjusted her hair, and with a little love-smile of anticipation on her lips put on a dressing-gown——another of the marvelous pretties of Francis’ forethought and providing.", "sha256": "06bf5331412324a44daa4f214bdb189d2e541260f5fc888857bb7694e6e99578", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2279]", "source_html": "

Peeping in, she saw two men drawn up in big leather chairs near to each other and facing. Francis, tired of face from the day’s exertions, still wore his business suit; but the other was clad in evening dress. And she heard him call her husband “Francis,” who, in turn, called him “Johnny.” That, and the familiarity of their conversation, conveyed to her that they were old, close friends.", "sha256": "2bdaeab99b8f91cee1210e5a6ad798a29e4ece6cb639152e8d257917d42e3e4a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2280]", "source_html": "

At the entrance of the library she paused, hearing the voice of another than Francis. At first thought she decided it was the flying speech, but immediately afterward she knew it to be too loud and near and different. Peeping in, she saw two men drawn up in big leather chairs near to each other and facing. Francis, tired of face from the day’s exertions, still wore his business suit; but the other was clad in evening dress. And she heard him call her husband “Francis,” who, in turn, called him “Johnny.” That, and the familiarity of their conversation, conveyed to her that they were old, close friends.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u026-r0076", "tag": "p", "text": "“And don’t tell me, Francis,” the other was saying, “that you’ve frivoled through Panama all this while without losing your heart to the senoritas a dozen times.”", "sha256": "e8f7aebb595c61da2bbac0cad86cd7198a54b4cedef2b574802d4b7d618b0134", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2281]", "source_html": "

“And don’t tell me, Francis,” the other was saying, “that you’ve frivoled through Panama all this while without losing your heart to the senoritas a dozen times.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u026-r0077", "tag": "p", "text": "“Only once,” Francis replied, after a pause, in which the Queen noted that he gazed steadily at his friend.", "sha256": "5928e43ba7cd21ef2893a2b8ed1b270cee098bc4a1d4b7c4b03045ef85cab185", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2282]", "source_html": "

“Only once,” Francis replied, after a pause, in which the Queen noted that he gazed steadily at his friend.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u026-r0078", "tag": "p", "text": "“Further,” he went on, after another pause, “I really lost my heart——but not my head. Johnny Pathmore, O Johnny Pathmore, you are a mere flirtatious brute, but I tell you that you’ve lots to learn. I tell you that in Panama I found the most wonderful woman in the world——a woman that I was glad I had lived to know, a woman that I would gladly die for; a woman of fire, of passion, of sweetness, of nobility, a very queen of women.”", "sha256": "569fcfd46f032a36130d58ccf963472f28f02be8f51409ade9186f356703cf82", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2283]", "source_html": "
